title: On self-dualities for scalar $φ^4$ theory
summary: Scalar field theory is studied by constructing interacting saddle point expansions in the symmetric and broken phase, respectively. Focusing on analytically tractable saddle expansions, it is found that broken and symmetric phases are related by sign flip of the quartic coupling. Applications to dimensions $d<4$ recover previous results for the phase diagram, whereas $d=4$ is possibly new.
